sections.title: Mixing verbs
sections.content: When talking about a full day, you will mix reflexive verbs (for personal care routines) and regular verbs (for other actions).

items.spanish: Me levanto a las ocho y desayuno.
items.english: I get up at eight and have breakfast.

items.spanish: Carlos trabaja todo el día y luego se acuesta.
items.english: Carlos works all day and then goes to bed.
